typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Id as string,
		{Contact__r.Customer_Id__c} as string,
		{Contact__r.Id} as string,
		{Contact__r.Type__c} as string,
		Preferred_Spoken_Language__c as string,
		OTN__c as string,
		{Contact__r.FirstName} as string,
		{Contact__r.middle_initial__c} as string,
		{Contact__r.LastName} as string,
		{Contact__r.Birthdate} as string,
		{Contact__r.HomePhone} as string,
		{Contact__r.OtherStreet} as string,
		{Contact__r.OtherCity} as string,
		{Contact__r.OtherState} as string,
		{Contact__r.OtherPostalCode} as string,
		{Contact__r.MailingStreet} as string,
		{Contact__r.MailingCity} as string,
		{Contact__r.MailingState} as string,
		{Contact__r.MailingPostalCode} as string,
		Agent_NPN__c as string,
		Agent_Lic_State__c as string,
		Agent_Licensed__c as string,
		{Owner.Id} as string,
		{Owner.Name} as string,
		{Owner.Phone} as string,
		{Owner.Email} as string,
		Method__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['salesforce/ob_fulfillment_orders*']) ~> source1
source(output(
		Fulfillment_Order__c as string,
		OTN__c as string,
		Num_Apps_Req__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['fulfillment_orders_Fulfillment_Orders_Line_Items*']) ~> LineItems
source(output(
		ParentId as string,
		OwnerId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['fulfillment_orders_Account.csv']) ~> Account
source(output(
		Id as string,
		URL__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['fulfillment_orders_User.csv']) ~> User
source1, SelectItems join(Id == Fulfillment_Order__c,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join1
Join3 derive(extract_dt = toString(currentDate(), 'yyyyMMdd'),
		zip = split({Contact__r.OtherPostalCode}, '-')[1],
		zip4 = split({Contact__r.OtherPostalCode}, '-')[2],
		mailing_to_zip = split({Contact__r.MailingPostalCode}, '-')[1],
		mailing_to_zip4 = split({Contact__r.MailingPostalCode}, '-')[2],
		promo_id = toString(null()),
		population = toString(null()),
		rate_up_tier = toString(null()),
		{Contact__r.Birthdate} = replace(left({Contact__r.Birthdate}, 10), '-', ''),
		app_otn = toString(null()),
		agent_rep_ext = toString(null()),
		cover_letter_version = toString(null()),
		fulfillment_order_originator = 'CNX') ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		extract_dt,
		prospect_id = {Contact__r.Customer_Id__c},
		family_account_id = ParentId,
		promo_id,
		cnx_contact_id = {Contact__r.Id},
		cnx_primary_contact_id = {Contact__r.Id},
		role = {Contact__r.Type__c},
		population,
		rate_up_tier,
		language = Preferred_Spoken_Language__c,
		fulfillment_code = source1@OTN__c,
		first_nm = {Contact__r.FirstName},
		middle_nm = {Contact__r.middle_initial__c},
		last_nm = {Contact__r.LastName},
		address_1 = {Contact__r.OtherStreet},
		address_2 = {Contact__r.OtherStreet},
		city = {Contact__r.OtherCity},
		state = {Contact__r.OtherStreet},
		zip,
		zip4,
		dob = {Contact__r.Birthdate},
		phone_number = {Contact__r.HomePhone},
		mailing_first_nm = {Contact__r.FirstName},
		mailing_middle_nm = {Contact__r.middle_initial__c},
		mailing_last_nm = {Contact__r.LastName},
		mailing_address_1 = {Contact__r.MailingStreet},
		mailing_address_2 = {Contact__r.MailingStreet},
		mailing_to_city = {Contact__r.MailingCity},
		mailing_to_state = {Contact__r.MailingState},
		mailing_to_zip,
		mailing_to_zip4,
		app_otn,
		num_apps_req = Num_Apps_Req__c,
		agent_rep_id = Agent_NPN__c,
		agent_rep_lic_state = Agent_Lic_State__c,
		agent_rep_lic = Agent_Licensed__c,
		agent_rep_first_and_last_nm = {Owner.Name},
		agent_rep_phone = {Owner.Phone},
		agent_rep_ext,
		agent_email_address = {Owner.Email},
		url = URL__c,
		cover_letter_version,
		fulfillment_order_originator,
		fulfillment_order_id = source1@Id,
		shipment_method = Method__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Join4, SelectAccount join({Owner.Id} == OwnerId,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join3
Join1, SelectUser join({Owner.Id} == SelectUser@Id,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join4
LineItems aggregate(groupBy(mycols = sha2(256,columns())),
	each(match(true()), $$ = first($$))) ~> Aggregate1
Account aggregate(groupBy(mycols = sha2(256,columns())),
	each(match(true()), $$ = first($$))) ~> Aggregate3
User aggregate(groupBy(mycols = sha2(256,columns())),
	each(match(true()), $$ = first($$))) ~> Aggregate4
Aggregate1 select(mapColumn(
		Fulfillment_Order__c,
		OTN__c,
		Num_Apps_Req__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SelectItems
Aggregate3 select(mapColumn(
		ParentId,
		OwnerId
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SelectAccount
Aggregate4 select(mapColumn(
		Id,
		URL__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SelectUser
Select1 filter(!isNull(extract_dt)&&!isNull(fulfillment_code)&&!isNull(first_nm)&&!isNull(last_nm)&&!isNull(address_1)&&!isNull(city)&&!isNull(state)&&!isNull(zip)&&!isNull(mailing_address_1)&&!isNull(mailing_address_2)&&!isNull(mailing_to_city)&&!isNull(mailing_to_state)&&!isNull(mailing_to_zip)&&!isNull(fulfillment_order_id)) ~> Filter1
Filter1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('fulfillment_orders_', toString(currentUTC(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'), '.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sink1
